description: Semantic code intelligence for AI coding agents on C#/.NET - before an agent changes your code, understand the impact. A Roslyn MCP server and command line for semantic code analysis and navigation: it answers who calls a symbol, the impact of a change, which tests cover it and what dependency injection resolves, plus side effects, dead code and dependency cycles - then packs token-budgeted Markdown context for language models. It does not edit your code: it tells the agent what a refactoring will touch before the edit. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and any MCP client over stdio. The Windows desktop app is a separate download.
